state.product: pi-vida: personal per-language agent harness. Direction (owner, 2026-09-22): personal daily driver; skills/packs layer meant to be shared. Jev 001 (same day) confirmed invest zones: modes, host projection cline/kilo, solo launch, herdr integration.
state.owner_context: Owner uses --host projection daily (kilo ~70 percent, cline ~30 percent, claude never) and reports NO pain with the current path: skills are projected into host dirs and the host is exec'd. These candidates are improvements, not pain relief.

sdk_research_2026_09_22.cline_sdk: @cline/sdk (Node 22+). Surfaces the CLI projection cannot offer: plugins with bundled file-based SKILL.md skills auto-surfaced as slash commands and distributable via npm/git; tool-intercept hooks; configured agents and multi-agent teams; cron/one-off scheduling; ClineCore headless sessions with events and persistence, no TTY.
sdk_research_2026_09_22.kilo_sdk: @kilocode/sdk v7 exists, server-based v2 API. Kilo is the owner's primary host (~70 percent).

candidates.cline_plugin_packaging: Ship each vida as a Cline plugin: skills bundled as SKILL.md inside the package, auto-surfaced as slash commands, distributed via npm/git. Replaces manual skills projection for cline; strengthens the shared skills/packs layer story.
candidates.enforcement_hooks: Move damage-control from a prompt-level gate to real tool-intercept hooks via the Cline SDK, so blocked actions (git push, .env writes, writes outside cwd) are enforced programmatically in cline sessions.
candidates.native_teams_cline: Map pi-vida team mode (dispatcher + planner/builder/reviewer/researcher) onto Cline SDK configured agents/teams instead of hidden children or herdr panes, for cline-hosted sessions.
candidates.sdk_scheduling: Use Cline SDK cron/one-off scheduling for recurring harness tasks (e.g. nightly review sweeps, pack update checks).
candidates.headless_ci_runs: Use ClineCore headless sessions (events, persistence, no TTY) to run vidas from scripts/CI without an interactive terminal.
candidates.kilo_sdk_path: Mirror/improve the kilo projection using @kilocode/sdk v2 (server-based) for the owner's primary host.
